On the console (PS5/PS4): Settings → Users and Accounts → Privacy → Customise.
Find \"Trophy level, games and showcases\" (or \"Trophies\") and set it to \"Anyone\".
From your phone: PlayStation app → your profile → settings icon → Account privacy → Trophies.
The change is instant — no need to sign in again.
On your Steam profile (web or client) → \"Edit Profile\" → \"Privacy Settings\".
The one almost everyone misses: set \"Game details\" to Public TOO — without it, Steam won\'t let us read your library.

Find \"Game history & stats\" and set it to \"Everyone\".
